def run_checkout_demo(raw_items: List[str], coupon: str = "") -> str:
    service = build_demo_service()
    customer = Customer("cust-100", "reader@example.com", 20000, "vip")
    items = parse_cart(raw_items)
    order = service.checkout(customer, items, coupon)
    history = service.customer_history(customer.customer_id)
    return f"created={order.order_id}; status={order.status}; history_count={len(history)}"

commerce_ops_demo.commerce_ops.services..name: OrderService
commerce_ops_demo.commerce_ops.services..source_code:
class OrderService:
    def __init__(
        self,
        catalog: ProductCatalog,
        pricing: PricingPolicy,
        payments: PaymentGateway,
        repository: OrderRepository,
        notifications: NotificationService,
    ):
        self.catalog = catalog
        self.pricing = pricing
        self.payments = payments
        self.repository = repository
        self.notifications = notifications
        self.last_receipt: PaymentReceipt | None = None

    def checkout(self, customer: Customer, items: List[CartItem], coupon: str = "") -> Order:
        reserved_products = self.catalog.reserve_items(items)
        try:
            quote = self.pricing.quote(customer, items, reserved_products, coupon)
            order = self._build_order(customer, items, quote)
            receipt = self._charge(customer, quote)
            order.mark_paid(receipt.payment_id)
            self.repository.save(order)
            self._notify_customer(customer, order, reserved_products)
            return order
        except Exception:
            self.catalog.release_items(items)
            raise

    def cancel_order(self, order_id: str, reason: str) -> Order:
        order = self.repository.get(order_id)
        order.mark_cancelled(reason)
        self.catalog.release_items(order.items)
        self.repository.save(order)
        return order

    def customer_history(self, customer_id: str) -> List[Dict[str, str]]:
        orders = self.repository.list_by_customer(customer_id)
        return [
            {"order_id": order.order_id, "status": order.status, "total": str(order.total_cents)}
            for order in orders
        ]

    def _build_order(self, customer: Customer, items: List[CartItem], quote: PriceQuote) -> Order:
        order = Order(str(uuid4()), customer.customer_id, list(items), quote.total_cents)
        order.add_event("quoted", f"subtotal={quote.subtotal_cents}; discount={quote.discount_cents}; tax={quote.tax_cents}")
        return order

    def _charge(self, customer: Customer, quote: PriceQuote) -> PaymentReceipt:
        receipt = self.payments.authorize(customer, quote.total_cents)
        self.last_receipt = receipt
        return receipt

    def _notify_customer(self, customer: Customer, order: Order, products) -> None:
        self.notifications.send_receipt(customer, order)
        self.notifications.send_low_stock_alert(products)
